en.title: Best Baby Monitors 2026
en.description: Eight baby monitors ranked on privacy architecture, monitoring features, reliability, and real-world safety and recall history, not just video quality.

zh-tw.title: 2026 最佳嬰兒監視器
zh-tw.description: 八款嬰兒監視器完整排名，不只比畫質，連隱私架構、連線穩定度到實際的安全與回收紀錄都一次看清楚。

en.description: A WiFi overhead camera with AES-256 encryption, mandatory two-factor authentication, and sleep-tracking analytics that turn months of nursery footage into readable sleep trends.

zh-tw.description: WiFi 連線的俯視角攝影機，256 位元 AES 加密加上強制雙重驗證，還會把好幾個月的夜間畫面整理成看得懂的睡眠趨勢報告。

en.description: A non-WiFi monitor that sends video over a private 2.4GHz FHSS radio link instead of the internet, so there's no app, no cloud account, and no remote server for anyone to break into.

zh-tw.description: 完全不連網路的監視器，用私有的 2.4GHz 跳頻無線電訊號傳輸畫面，不用裝 App、不用註冊雲端帳號，等於沒有任何遠端伺服器能被入侵。

en.description: Pairs a wearable smart sock that tracks heart rate and oxygen saturation with an HD camera, giving parents a live vitals readout alongside the video feed through Owlet's cloud app and 128-bit encryption.

zh-tw.description: 把會量心跳跟血氧的穿戴式智慧襪子跟一台 HD 攝影機綁在一起，爸媽打開 Owlet 的雲端 App 就能同時看到寶寶的生理數據跟即時畫面，加密等級是 128 位元。

en.description: A 2.5K cloud camera built around AI detection that flags rollovers, face covering, and coughing in real time, six times faster than the previous generation.

zh-tw.description: 2.5K 畫質的雲端攝影機，主打 AI 偵測，寶寶翻身、臉被蓋住、咳嗽都能即時跳通知，偵測速度比上一代快六倍。

en.description: A local-storage monitor with no monthly fee, from a brand that paid New York's Attorney General $450,000 in 2025 after regulators found camera feeds reachable without authentication despite a zero-cloud marketing promise.

zh-tw.description: 主打本機儲存、不用月費的款式，來自 2025 年因為零雲端行銷卻被查出畫面能在未驗證下被外部存取，而付了 45 萬美元和解金給紐約州檢察總長的品牌。

en.description: A contact-free monitor using radar-like SensorFusion technology to track breathing and movement without a wearable, though full functionality requires a monthly Care+ membership.

zh-tw.description: 不用穿戴任何裝置，靠類雷達的 SensorFusion 技術直接感測寶寶的呼吸跟動作，不過完整功能需要另外付 Care+ 月費才能用。

en.description: A budget non-WiFi monitor with a 1,000-foot range and a 19-hour battery life on the parent unit, proof that skipping the cloud doesn't mean skipping real range.

zh-tw.description: 平價不連網路款式，距離可以拉到 1000 英呎，父母機單次續航 19 小時，不走雲端路線一樣能有紮實的距離表現。

en.description: A non-WiFi split-screen monitor supporting up to 3 cameras, recalled by the CPSC in February 2026 after Hisense-manufactured units were found to overheat and spark while charging.

zh-tw.description: 不連網路的分割畫面監視器，最多能接 3 支攝影機，2026 年 2 月被美國消費品安全委員會回收，原因是海信代工的機台充電時會過熱甚至冒火花。

en.commentary:
I built this ranking around a question that matters more for baby monitors than almost any other product category: what happens to the video of your child's room after it leaves the camera? A French security researcher named Sammy Azdoufal answered that question in the worst possible way this year. He found five serious flaws in a white-label platform called Meari that powers the cloud backend for more than 300 camera brands, including Arenti, Boifun, ieGeek, CloudEdge, Intelbras, Wyze, and Petcube. The flaws let a stranger with nothing more than a free account pull motion-triggered screenshots from other people's nurseries, because the links to those images carried no signature, no expiration, and no login requirement. Roughly 1.1 million cameras across 118 countries were exposed. None of the eight monitors in this ranking run on Meari's platform, but that incident is exactly why I weighted architecture so heavily here.

Nanit Pro takes the top spot because it does the cloud model right. AES-256 encryption, mandatory two-factor authentication, and a privacy policy that commits to never selling your data all support that claim, and the sleep analytics genuinely earn their keep. Infant Optics DXR-8 Pro is my pick for parents who want zero exposure, period. It skips WiFi entirely and sends video over a private 2.4GHz radio link, so there's no app, no account, and no cloud server for anyone to breach.

I scored Eufy's SpaceView S lower on trust than its specs deserve. The $79 price and local storage sound great, until you learn Eufy paid New York's Attorney General $450,000 in 2025 after regulators found camera feeds reachable without authentication, despite marketing a zero-cloud promise. I still rank it, because the hardware itself is solid, but parents deserve that history before they buy.

Babysense Max View sits last because of a real fire hazard. The CPSC recalled roughly 81,800 units in February 2026 after finding that the parent display unit could overheat and spark while charging. This recall is exactly why safety gets its own column in this ranking, separate from privacy.

highlights.title: Nanit Pro earns the top spot by doing cloud monitoring responsibly
highlights.body: AES-256 encryption, mandatory two-factor authentication, and a no-data-sale privacy policy give Nanit Pro the kind of cloud architecture the Meari breach showed most of the industry is missing. Add sleep analytics that actually turn months of footage into usable trends, and it's the easiest overall recommendation here.

highlights.title: Infant Optics DXR-8 Pro is the only monitor here with zero exposure surface
highlights.body: No WiFi, no app, no cloud account, and no remote server means there's nothing for an attacker to reach in the first place. Video travels over a private 2.4GHz FHSS radio link directly between the camera and the parent unit. Against a backdrop of a supply-chain breach that exposed 1.1 million cameras, that architecture is the strongest privacy guarantee you can buy.

highlights.title: Eufy's $79 price comes with a trust tax you should know about
highlights.body: A security researcher found Eufy uploading thumbnail data to the cloud in 2022 despite marketing a fully local, zero-cloud experience, and New York's Attorney General followed up with a $450,000 settlement in 2025 after finding video feeds reachable without authentication. The hardware is genuinely good value. The marketing claims need a discount applied.

highlights.title: Babysense Max View's recall exposes a real fire hazard
highlights.body: The CPSC recalled about 81,800 units of this Hisense-manufactured monitor in February 2026 after the parent display unit was found to overheat and spark while charging, with 11 incidents reported and no injuries so far. Units were sold through Amazon, Walmart, and Babylist between January 2023 and December 2025. That recall is exactly why this ranking tracks safety as its own factor, separate from privacy.

zh-tw.commentary:
這次排行榜我只想問一件事，寶寶房間的監視畫面，離開攝影機之後到底去了哪裡。這個問題今年被一位法國資安研究員 Sammy Azdoufal 用最糟的方式回答了。他在一個叫 Meari 的白牌雲端平台上抓出五個嚴重漏洞，這個平台撐起超過 300 個攝影機品牌的雲端後台，包括 Arenti、Boifun、ieGeek、CloudEdge、Intelbras、Wyze 跟 Petcube。漏洞讓外人只要申請一個免費帳號，就能看到別人家觸發動態偵測的截圖，因為那些截圖的連結完全沒有簽章、沒有過期時間，也不用登入。全球 118 個國家、大約 110 萬台攝影機受影響。這份榜單上的八款監視器都不是建立在 Meari 平台上，但這起事件正是我把架構安全性看得這麼重的原因。

Nanit Pro 能排第一，是因為它把雲端這條路走得正確。256 位元 AES 加密、強制雙重驗證，隱私政策也明白承諾不賣用戶資料，睡眠分析功能也真的有實用價值。Infant Optics DXR-8 Pro 則是我推薦給完全不想冒險的爸媽的選擇，它根本不連 WiFi，畫面走私有的 2.4GHz 無線電訊號傳輸，沒有 App、沒有帳號，也沒有雲端伺服器可以被攻破。

Eufy SpaceView S 我給的信任分數比規格應得的要低一點。79 美元的價格加上本機儲存聽起來很棒，直到你知道 Eufy 在 2025 年因為被紐約州檢察總長查出，明明主打零雲端，畫面卻能在沒有驗證的情況下被外部存取，付了 45 萬美元和解金。我還是把它放進榜單，因為硬體本身真的不錯，但這段歷史買之前最好先知道。

Babysense Max View 排在最後，理由是一起真正的火災風險。CPSC 在 2026 年 2 月回收了大約 8.18 萬台，原因是親機顯示單元充電時會過熱甚至冒火花。這起回收正是這份榜單把安全與隱私分開獨立計分的原因。

highlights.title: Nanit Pro 把雲端監控這條路走得負責任，才拿下第一
highlights.body: 256 位元 AES 加密、強制雙重驗證，隱私政策也承諾不賣用戶資料，這套雲端架構正好是 Meari 這起事件凸顯出大多數業者沒做到的水準。再加上睡眠分析功能真的能把好幾個月的畫面變成看得懂的趨勢報告，綜合起來是這份榜單裡最沒有懸念的推薦。

highlights.title: Infant Optics DXR-8 Pro 是這份榜單裡唯一零暴露面的選擇
highlights.body: 沒有 WiFi、沒有 App、沒有雲端帳號，也沒有遠端伺服器，等於從一開始就沒有東西能讓攻擊者下手。畫面是透過私有的 2.4GHz 跳頻無線電訊號，在攝影機跟父母機之間直接傳輸。對照那起讓 110 萬台攝影機曝光的供應鏈級資安事件，這種架構是目前買得到最硬的隱私保證。

highlights.title: Eufy 79 美元的價格背後藏著一筆信任代價
highlights.body: 一位資安研究員在 2022 年就發現 Eufy 明明主打完全本機儲存、零雲端，實際上卻把縮圖資料上傳到雲端，紐約州檢察總長後續在 2025 年查出畫面能在未驗證的情況下被外部存取，最後開出 45 萬美元和解金。硬體規格本身確實物超所值，但行銷說法得打個折扣來看。

highlights.title: Babysense Max View 的回收紀錄曝露出火災風險
highlights.body: CPSC 在 2026 年 2 月回收了大約 8.18 萬台這款由海信代工的監視器，原因是親機顯示單元充電時會過熱甚至冒火花，目前已有 11 起事故回報，所幸尚無人員受傷。受影響機型在 2023 年 1 月到 2025 年 12 月間透過 Amazon、Walmart 跟 Babylist 銷售。這起回收正是這份榜單把安全跟隱私分開獨立計分的原因。
